source.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py -k "pretool or guard or background"

claims.claim: Created .agents/aios_antigravity_pretool_guard.py: stdlib-only Python guard that parses Antigravity PreToolUse protojson toolCall.args.CommandLine input defensively, is fully inert when AIOS_ANTIGRAVITY_ACTIVE is unset, denies runtime-owned verification (pytest, tox, mvn, gradle, npm test/build, yarn, cargo, go, make test/build/check, coverage, nox, ruff, black, isort, mypy, flake8, pylint) with reason AIOS_RUNTIME_OWNS_VERIFICATION, denies background-risk commands (sleep, timeout, wait, start-sleep, nohup, watch, tail -f, npm run dev/watch/start, flask run, uvicorn, gunicorn, python -m http.server, manage_task, schedule, and trailing &) with reason AIOS_BACKGROUND_RISK_DENIED, denies re-invocation of agy or AIOS operator launchers with reason AIOS_RUNTIME_OWNS_VERIFICATION, allows bounded git terminalization (status, diff, add, commit, rev-parse, log, show, branch, remote, ls-files, stash, tag, fetch, merge, rebase, reset, restore), and fails closed on malformed stdin/empty payload with reason AIOS_GUARD_MALFORMED_INPUT.

Created .agents/hooks.json: workspace hook config with matcher='run_command' wired to aios_antigravity_pretool_guard.py under the entry key aios-antigravity-pretool-run-command with enabled=true. Hook command path uses ./aios_antigravity_pretool_guard.py relative to hooks.json directory (.agents/) so it resolves regardless of workspace cwd.

Modified src/aios_renew/antigravity_adapter.py: added AIOS_ANTIGRAVITY_ACTIVE_ENV='AIOS_ANTIGRAVITY_ACTIVE', AIOS_ANTIGRAVITY_ACTIVE_VALUE='1', AIOS_PRETOOL_GUARD_FILENAME constants plus aios_subprocess_env() and aios_pretool_guard_path(repo) helpers. The _invoke_native() chokepoint now injects env=aios_subprocess_env() into self._runner(...), preserving caller environment via **os.environ merge and propagating only the AIOS_ANTIGRAVITY_ACTIVE=1 marker to the agy subprocess. No global os.environ mutation.

Modified tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py: appended 72 TASK-138 regression tests covering (a) canonical repo-file presence of guard script and hooks.json, (b) aios_subprocess_env() preserves caller env while adding AIOS_ANTIGRAVITY_ACTIVE, (c) inactive guard is fully inert (returns allow for any command, including pytest / agy / npm run dev), (d) active guard denies all listed verification tokens (pytest tests/test_authoring_ingress.py, python -m pytest ..., tox, npm test, yarn test, make test, cargo test, go test, ruff check, black, isort, mypy, coverage), (e) RUN-136-004 failure class explicitly covered, (f) active guard denies background-risk commands (Start-Sleep, sleep, timeout, nohup &, tail -f, npm run dev, npm start, uvicorn, flask run, http.server, gunicorn, trailing &, trailing &\n), (g) active guard denies re-invocation of agy and AIOS operator launchers, (h) active guard allows bounded git terminalization (status, diff, add, commit, rev-parse, log, show, branch, remote), (i) malformed stdin (empty, not json, [], null, 42, 'string', {}) fails closed with reason AIOS_GUARD_MALFORMED_INPUT in active mode but is silently allowed in inactive mode, (j) Windows path-with-spaces commands are correctly classified, (k) adapter subprocess env contains AIOS_ANTIGRAVITY_ACTIVE=1 without mutating caller os.environ, (l) adapter still emits exactly one runner call per execute/execute_remediation (preserves TASK-137 finish-exactly-once semantics).

Live self-host proof: ran agy 1.2.6 with --print --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json --dangerously-skip-permissions --add-dir <repo> --disable-slash-commands with AIOS_ANTIGRAVITY_ACTIVE=1 in the subprocess env. agy surfaced 'tool call denied by pre-tool hook: AIOS_RUNTIME_OWNS_VERIFICATION' on pytest tests/test_authoring_ingress.py, and emitted status=SUCCESS on git status, demonstrating the workspace hook is loaded, the activation marker is propagated, and the guard is otherwise inert.

Repository state and commit: TASK-138 implementation committed as a single canonical commit 'task: implement TASK-138 native Antigravity PreToolUse guard' on main. Final HEAD ec7da7662819dd11b2f8824daf85b340a439c2e7; working tree clean; .agents/hooks.json and .agents/aios_antigravity_pretool_guard.py are tracked canonical repo files (not runtime residue). TASK-137 deterministic terminal contract preserved (one runner call per execute; finish-exactly-once; fail-closed on malformed input). All 140 tests in tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py pass under pytest 9 with no regression in pre-existing TASK-136/137 suite.
